heading: Pak in crisis: PTI to hold Sept 27 stir 'at all costs' for release of Imran Khan
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf plans a protest on September 27 for Imran Khan's release. Legal challenges have been filed against the detention of his three sisters. The party insists the demonstrations will proceed despite arrests of its leaders. Authorities state the protest will not be allowed to disrupt the capital city. Imran Khan's son condemned the detentions and called for international intervention.
